description_good_justification: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet#readme opens by stating that AntHocNet is an ant-colony-optimization routing protocol for mobile ad hoc networks: it finds and maintains routes between nodes whose wireless links keep changing, as a simulator-agnostic C++ core with an ns-3 adapter and a WebAssembly browser adapter.
interact_justification: Obtain: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet#readme and https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/releases. Feedback: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues (issue forms for bugs and features); support: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/SUPPORT.md. Contribute: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md.
contribution_justification: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md documents the process: branch from main, open a PR, CI must pass, review, squash merge.
contribution_requirements_justification: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style: C++14 and the repository .clang-format (checked in CI), Conventional Commit PR titles, a test for any new behaviour, routing logic only in core/.
floss_license_justification: GPL-2.0-only (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/LICENSE); core/ and tooling are MIT OR GPL-2.0-only (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/LICENSING.md).
documentation_interface_justification: API reference (Doxygen): https://swarm-routing.github.io/AntHocNet/api/. Configuration inputs: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/docs/configuration.md. Wire format: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/docs/wire-format.md. Run outputs: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/docs/comparison-harness.md.
sites_https_justification: GitHub and swarm-routing.github.io are served over HTTPS only.
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues): searchable, URL-addressable, open to new participants, no proprietary client needed.
english_justification: All documentation, code comments, issues and pull requests are in English; reports are accepted in English at https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues.
maintained_justification: Active: commits to main this week (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/commits/main), 89 PRs merged in the last 30 days, releases v2.5.0-v2.6.1 in 2026-10 (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/releases).
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with its author and date.
repo_interim_justification: Every change lands on main through a public PR (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/pulls?q=is%3Apr), so main carries every interim version between releases (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/commits/main).
version_unique_justification: Each release has a unique semantic version: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/VERSION, git tags (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/tags), GitHub Releases (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/releases); set by Commitizen (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.cz.toml).
version_semver_justification: Semantic Versioning, bumped by Commitizen from Conventional Commit titles (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.cz.toml, https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
version_tags_justification: Every release is a git tag vX.Y.Z (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/tags), created by https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml when the bump PR merges.
release_notes_vulns_justification: No publicly known vulnerability with a CVE or similar identifier has been fixed in any release (no advisories: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/security/advisories; none in https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
report_tracker_justification: GitHub Issues (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues) with issue forms and type/area/priority labels; process: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/docs/adr/0013-track-bugs-and-findings-as-issues.md.
report_responses_justification: All 43 bug reports filed 2-12 months ago were acknowledged (triaged, commented or closed): https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Abug. All were filed by the maintainer.
enhancement_responses_justification: 96 of 109 enhancement requests filed 2-12 months ago (88%) have a response: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aenhancement.
report_archive_justification: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/issues?q=is%3Aissue: every report and response, open and closed, public and searchable.
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability reports received in the last 6 months (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/security/advisories); SECURITY.md promises an acknowledgement within a few days.
build_justification: make test (CMake) builds the core; make install-ns3 builds the ns-3 module (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building--testing).
build_common_tools_justification: CMake, GNU Make, ns-3's CMake/Ninja build.
build_floss_tools_justification: GCC or Clang, CMake, GNU Make, ns-3, Emscripten: all FLOSS; CI builds on Ubuntu with these only (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml).
test_justification: Core unit tests (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/tree/main/core/tests, ctest) and the ns-3 suite (./test.py -s anthocnet), documented in https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building--testing and run by CI (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml).
test_most_justification: Core unit tests, codec fuzzing and the ns-3 suite; coverage reported on every PR (https://codecov.io/gh/swarm-routing/AntHocNet).
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: GitHub Actions on every PR and push (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml); the CI gate check is required by the main ruleset.
test_policy_justification: https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#building--testing: make test must stay green and any new behaviour needs a test; routing changes need a core/tests/ unit test.
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes add tests (golden rule 7 in https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/AGENTS.md; enforced in review).
warnings_fixed_justification: Compiler warnings are fixed as they appear; the core builds warning-free in CI.
crypto_published_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_call_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_floss_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_keylength_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_working_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_pfs_justification: N/A: the project implements and uses no cryptography.
crypto_random_justification: No cryptographic keys or nonces are generated; simulation randomness comes from seeded simulator streams.
delivery_mitm_justification: Delivered over HTTPS only (GitHub Releases, GHCR) with SHA-256 checksums, Sigstore-signed SLSA provenance and cosign image signatures (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/SECURITY.md#verifying-a-release).
delivery_unsigned_justification: Checksums are published on the HTTPS release page and as HTTPS assets; nothing is fetched over HTTP.
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL (security-and-quality, C/C++) on every PR, merge group and weekly (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml); SonarQube Cloud (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml); clang-tidy.
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL's security-and-quality suite targets common C/C++ vulnerabilities.
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every PR and every push to main.
dynamic_analysis_justification: libFuzzer on the codec, the only parser of untrusted input (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci-core.yml, job codec-fuzz).
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: C++: core under ASan + UBSan and the ns-3 module under ASan + LSan in CI (https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci-core.yml, https://github.com/swarm-routing/AntHocNet/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci-ns3.yml).
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Tests and fuzzing run Debug builds with assertions on; ns-3 CI uses the debug image.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Sanitizer and fuzz failures fail CI and are fixed before merge.
